name: R5-SK1
description: R5-SK1 was an R5 series astromech droid that served as part of the Alliance to Restore the Republic's Red Squadron. It was stationed on the moon of Yavin 4 as part of the Massassi Group of Rebels headquartered in the Great Temple. It participated in the battle above the planet Scarif while docked into a T-65B X-wing starfighter.
